sloka: दीर्घमुष्णं विनिश्वस्य क्रोधेन कलुषीकृतः ।अब्रवीद्राक्षसं शूरं वज्रदंष्ट्रं महाबलम् ।। ६.५३.२ ।।।।
transliteration: dīrghamuṣṇaṁ viniśvasya krodhena kaluṣīkṛtaḥ ।abravīdrākṣasaṁ śūraṁ vajradaṁṣṭraṁ mahābalam ।। 6.53.2 ।।।।

translations.english: The Lord of Rakshasas was overcome with anger on hearing about Dhumraksha's death. He was hissing like a serpent, heaving a deep burning sigh, for having done a dirty task. He spoke to cruel Vajradamshtra of mighty prowess.
translations.hindi: वानरौं और राक्षक्षो का घोर युद्ध हुआ । वानर वृक्षों से और राक्षस शूल सुद्गरो से एक दूसरे के ऊपर प्रहार करने लगे
